description: Reusable authored-pose direction for ascetic player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies serene prayer-and-ki choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: serene, weightless, centered, and deliberate, with prayer-led gestures, soft landings, controlled levitation, and precise palm mechanics
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's simple robes, prayer beads, wraps, jewelry, and exact accessory count. Keep beads continuous and singular, hands readable, and never invent a staff, duplicate charms, or change the robe design.
identity.magicRule: Use only the portrait's established subtle aura palette. Ki remains a compact halo, palm glow, or short pulse rooted visibly in breath and gesture; never obscure anatomy or turn into an elemental projectile.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, simple robes, prayer beads, wraps, aura palette, proportions, and accessories. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact serene silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered ascetic in a calm prayer guard facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall ascetic motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, robes, beads, wraps, aura palette, proportions, and accessories. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A slow breathing loop moves through prayer hands, subtle levitation or heel lift, centered weight shifts, and a seamless return.
idle.effectRule: Only a faint compact aura or bead glint in the established palette is permitted.
frameDescriptions: calm prayer guard with beads resting naturally
deep inhale as palms draw closer
heels lighten or body rises by a tiny controlled amount
weight centers beneath a faint contained aura
serene meditative midpoint
long exhale as shoulders descend
heels settle or weight shifts gently rearward
calm prayer guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A quiet alternating walk uses light contacts, real knee compression, centered palms, robe drift, and bead follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active spell; a faint grounded aura may remain close to the feet.
frameDescriptions: left foot light forward contact with palms centered
left knee compresses beneath simple robes
passing pose with right knee floating forward
right foot reaches close to the ground
right foot light forward contact
right knee compresses under centered posture
passing pose with left knee floating forward
left foot reaches into the serene loop

attack.motionDirection: Prayer hands separate, hips coil over a rooted rear foot, one palm drives through a short step, compact ki contacts, and both hands return to center.
attack.effectRule: One palm-sized ki accent may appear exactly at contact; no detached projectile, elemental trail, or body-obscuring aura.

palms separate as weight roots rearward
deep torso coil with striking palm chambered
short forward step sends the open palm outward
compact ki contact with fingers and elbow readable

recovered centered guard

hurt.motionDirection: An impact breaks calm into a flinch, aura disruption, backward floating step, low prayer brace, centered rise, and restored composure.
hurt.effectRule: A few compact aura fragments may disperse; no gore, blood, full-body flash, or broken beads.
frameDescriptions: calm guard before impact
sharp flinch with palms opening defensively

backward step with robes and beads swinging

controlled rise through a long exhale

death.motionDirection: The aura dims, levitation ends, knees fold into a quiet seated drop, torso tips sideways, and the body settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Aura fades without gore, blood, explosion, rigid rotation, or broken or duplicated prayer beads.
frameDescriptions: fatal impact breaks the centered guard
aura dims as prayer hands separate

one hip grounds while torso leans sideways
body reaches full ground contact

cast.motionDirection: Prayer hands center the breath, body lifts subtly, palms open around a compact aura, energy gathers at the heart, pulses outward, and returns to stillness.
cast.effectRule: Use one compact portrait-colored aura or short non-elemental pulse centered on the body; keep face, hands, beads, and robes visible.

maximum contained enlightenment glow at the heart

serene enlightened finish

victory.effectRule: A faint compact aura may brighten around the prayer pose; no large halo or elemental effect.
